input: P-R-J review of extract pipeline data handoff (7 findings, P=26, R=26, gap=0)

verification_result.summary: P-R-J analysis is sound. 6/7 findings correctly identified. F02(P-R-J bypass) and F04(intent misclassification) are real blockers for data quality. F03(verdict staleness) is cosmetic until downstream verification pipeline is implemented. Condition: F01 + F06 must be resolved before next extract pipeline deployment.

reasoning: The P-R-J evaluation correctly identified 7 structural issues in the extract pipeline's data handoff. Verdicts are sound: 6 ACCEPT, 1 REJECT(F07 — substring diff adequacy). The reject decision on F07 is reasonable — the simple substring check + 30B fallback chain + 27B verify is a multi-layer defense that makes F07 low priority. However, the evaluation's critical gap is that it doesn't assess the actual operational impact of these issues — how many token budgets are lost to the timing data gap? How many facts are lost per night to the text fact omission? These impact metrics should be added. Additionally, I note that the 30B verify evaluation (eval_30b_verify.json) identified M03/M05 about extract completeness that the P-R-J didn't fully incorporate — F05 should have been split into two separate findings (fallback text omission + short turn user fact omission).

verification_items.check: F01 — call_llm() timing data loss: llama.cpp API provides complete data
verification_items.detail: Confirmed by live API test: llama.cpp returns usage(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) + timings(prompt_ms, predicted_ms, tokens/s). call_llm() must be enhanced to pass these through.
Confirmed via queue_writer.py source: enqueue_review(queue_status='reviewed') is default. Extract_result goes directly to 27B verify — no intermediate quality gate.

verification_items.check: F03 — review_facts.verdict never updated: severity assessment
verification_items.detail: Verdict staleness is real but low-impact currently because the P-R-J → review_facts UPDATE path doesn't exist yet. When P-R-J pipeline processes extract_results, this will become critical. Priority should be P1, not critical.

verification_items.check: F04 — MCP intent 50% accuracy: user_turn vs response confusion
verification_items.detail: Two specific misclassifications identified with turn IDs. root_cause analysis (response-based classification) is correct. Fix: user_turn should determine intent, not response.

verification_items.check: F05 — 30B fallback text fact omission: 2490ch response, 0 text facts
verification_items.detail: Critical quality issue. The 30B is the safety net — if even the safety net drops all text facts, long responses are never extracted. SYSTEM_FALLBACK_30B needs prompt engineering.

verification_items.check: F05 completeness — short turn user fact omission also exists
verification_items.detail: P-R-J didn't separate long-response omission (M03) from short-turn omission (M05). F05 should be two findings: (a) 30B fallback text omission, (b) 3B user_turn omission on short turns.

verification_items.check: F06 — activity_log body insufficient: missing faithfulness, retry data
verification_items.detail: 5-field body is insufficient for downstream verify. Faithfulness %, retry count, unfaithful fact list must be added.

verification_items.check: F07 — Rejected: substring diff adequacy as 1st-line defense
verification_items.detail: Agree with rejection. Multi-layer defense (substring → 30B fallback → 27B verify) makes substring-only concern acceptable.

disagreement_with_prj.rationale: While verdict never updates, there is no downstream consumer that depends on verdict being accurate yet. The pipeline stores results in activity_log.body (verified). review_facts.verdict is used by debate pipeline but not by extract pipeline. Downgrade to high.

disagreement_with_prj.verify_label: should be split into F05a (30B text omission) + F05b (3B user omission)
disagreement_with_prj.rationale: Two different root causes: one is 30B fallback prompt issue, other is 3B extraction priority logic. Different fixes needed.

projected_nightly_impact.data_loss_from_timing_gap: ~4681 extract runs without any latency/token metrics — no cost tracking possible
projected_nightly_impact.text_fact_loss_per_night: If 50% of long turns (>500ch) hit 30B fallback and 30B drops text facts, potentially hundreds of text facts lost nightly
projected_nightly_impact.intent_misclassification: 50% misclassification rate means ~2340 turns have wrong MCP intent tags — affects search/discoverability

feedback.proposer_improvement: F05 should be decomposed. Two different root causes (30B prompt, 3B logic) need separate findings with separate fix recommendations.
feedback.refuter_improvement: Good decision on F07. Consider flagging downstream impact analysis gaps (as I did here) even for accepted findings.
feedback.judge_improvement: P and R scores (26/26) are consistent. Consider operational impact scoring — a P_score that weights findings by actual production impact would be more useful.
